Download Her/Him and experience an AI that's truly present.

Chatty is a revolutionary artificial intelligence assistant powered by GPT-4 technologies. Thanks to Chatty, it helps you in many different areas such as writing stories, essays and tweets, while answering your questions instantly.

In a natural chat environment, you can easily communicate as if you were talking to your friend. Chatty supports you in important tasks such as searching for information, keeping up with the latest developments, speaking the news or planning for the future.

Grammer and Spelling Checker
The app can quickly correct grammatical, spelling and punctuation mistakes in your texts.

AI Writing Assistant
With Chatty, you can get personalized help with any writing project, from essays and speeches to lyrics and poems.

Math Solver
Chatty can solve any math problem in a snap and provide you with clear, step-by-step explanations.

Expert Coder
Our app can write and check any programming code, preventing potential bugs and errors.

Social Media Posts Creator
The app is here to help you generate eye-catching posts for your Twitter, Facebook, Instagram or LinkedIn profiles.

Email Generator
Creating sales, announcement or discount emails has never been easier! With Chatty, you can craft professional and compelling messages in a matter of seconds.

Try Chatty and explore the limits of the AI-powered assistant. However, we remind you that the application may sometimes produce inappropriate or unwanted content, and Chatty cannot be held responsible in this case. Be careful not to enter your personal information.

Chatty offers users a customizable experience. In this way, by assigning a specific role, you can enable Chatty to take on the functions required for that role.

For example, by assigning an instructor role, Chatty can help you with your assignments or share new information with you. By assigning a workplace assistant role, Chatty can remind you of your meetings or help you plan your work.

record.name: Trade AI: Chart AI Analysis
record.offering: Finance app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Trade AI – Your AI Powered Trading Assistant
Navigating the financial markets can be overwhelming, but Trade AI simplifies the process with advanced AI-driven chart analysis. Whether you're trading stocks, forex, or cryptocurrencies, understanding market trends and technical patterns is essential for making informed decisions. Trade AI leverages powerful AI algorithms to analyze charts, identify key technical indicators, and provide actionable insights, all from a single image.

With Trade AI, you no longer need to spend hours analyzing charts manually. Our AI technology processes real-time trading data and delivers clear, data-backed insights that help traders make smarter, more confident decisions.

How Trade AI Works:
1. Upload or capture an image of a trading chart (stock, forex, or crypto)
2. AI scans for patterns, trends, and key indicators such as support and resistance levels, moving averages, and price action
3. Receive AI-generated insights tailored to your trading strategy, helping you interpret market conditions and potential trade opportunities

By using Trade AI, traders of all experience levels can enhance their chart analysis skills, recognize technical analysis patterns, and optimize their trading approach.

Who Can Use Trade AI?

Whether you're a beginner exploring stock trading or a seasoned forex trader, Trade AI is designed to support a wide range of market participants. If you're looking for a fast, AI-powered way to analyze stocks, forex charts, and crypto trends, this app provides the tools to help you stay ahead.

-Stock traders seeking AI-enhanced stock trading analysis
-Forex traders looking for AI-driven forex trading insights
-Technical analysis enthusiasts who want a second opinion on market trends
-Chart AI users interested in AI-assisted chart analysis

No matter your experience level, Trade AI helps you make more informed trading decisions by breaking down complex chart analysis into easy-to-understand insights.

Why Choose Trade AI?

-AI-driven insights: Get automated technical analysis based on AI pattern recognition
-Quick and easy: Just upload an image of a stock, forex, or crypto chart to receive AI-generated insights
-Saves time: No need for manual chart analysis—let AI do the heavy lifting
-Supports multiple markets: Works for stocks, forex trading, and crypto markets

Disclaimer:
Trade AI does not provide financial or investment advice. The insights generated by the app are for educational purposes only and should not be used as the sole basis for making trading decisions. Stock trading and forex trading involve risk, and users should always conduct their own research and consult with a licensed financial professional before executing any trades.

Privacy Policy: https://sites.google.com/view/tradeai-privacy-policy

record.name: invideo: AI Video Editor
record.offering: Photo & Video app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Dirija suas ideias com agentes de IA. Assuma o controle total dos seus vídeos e edite com sua equipe, de forma colaborativa, em um editor de timeline de nível profissional. Gere imagens, vídeo, voz, som e música com 200+ modelos de IA — tudo no invideo.
De filmes e anúncios a visuais e áudios avulsos, o invideo reúne criação e edição em uma única suíte criativa. Comece com uma ideia, um roteiro ou suas próprias filmagens. Trabalhe com o Agent Two, faça edições precisas por conta própria ou vá direto aos modelos para criar o que você imaginar.

VOCÊ DIRIGE. OS AGENTES DE IA EDITAM.
Diga ao Agent Two o que você quer criar ou mudar. Transforme sua ideia em vídeo, dê forma a uma cena ou refine uma edição existente usando a linguagem do dia a dia.
Conduza a história, o ritmo, o visual e o som à medida que o projeto ganha forma. Continue dirigindo até o resultado ficar do jeito que você quer.

ASSUMA O CONTROLE DE CADA CORTE
Da direção com IA, passe a editar com as próprias mãos no editor do invideo. Cada edição feita pela IA continua editável, com controles manuais precisos em uma timeline multipista profissional.
Organize, apare e divida clipes. Ajuste camadas, transições, efeitos e cores. Anime com keyframes e estilize títulos e legendas. Equilibre diálogos, música e efeitos sonoros.
Conte com os agentes para fazer o projeto avançar e, depois, cuide pessoalmente dos detalhes. Você decide o visual, o som e o clima de cada momento.

GERE VISUAIS E ÁUDIO COM 200+ MODELOS DE IA
Explore 200+ modelos de IA para geração de imagem, vídeo, voz, som e música.
Crie uma imagem avulsa, dê vida a uma foto, gere um clipe de vídeo, dê voz às suas palavras ou componha música para uma nova ideia. Escolha o modelo que combina com a sua direção criativa e explore diferentes possibilidades.
Use suas criações de forma independente ou leve-as para o editor junto com suas filmagens. De uma única peça a uma produção completa, continue criando em um só lugar.

EDIÇÃO COLABORATIVA DE VERDADE
Convide sua equipe para o projeto. Colabore em tempo real, deixe comentários em frames específicos e refine o trabalho em conjunto.
Mantenha a direção criativa, a revisão e a edição conectadas enquanto seu projeto avança rumo ao corte final.

PARA HISTÓRIAS, CAMPANHAS E SUA PRÓXIMA IDEIA
Dirija um curta-metragem. Monte um anúncio de produto. Crie reels, vídeos explicativos e conteúdo para o YouTube. Explore um conceito visual ou desenvolva o som do seu próximo projeto.
Traga sua visão para o invideo — e leve-a da primeira ideia aos retoques finais.

NEW! Take your conversations to the next level! Now, our chatbot doesn’t just reply—it creates. With our new Text-to-Image feature, you can instantly transform any idea, prompt, or concept into stunning visual art. If you can imagine it with words, Lorka can draw it for you.

Chat with Multiple AI Models

-Ask questions and get instant answers

-Chat naturally with AI in real time

-Explore ideas and compare responses from Claude, Gemini, Qwen, Grok, DeepSeek, and others

-Continue your web chats on mobile, accessing your full history and ongoing sessions

-Travel: plan trips, get recommendations, and organize details

-Writing: brainstorm ideas, draft texts, or refine documents

-Work & Finance: get insights, summaries, and quick answers for professional or personal use

Who is Lorka For?
-Anyone looking for an all-in-one AI assistant to handle multiple tasks

-Users who want chat, insights, and guidance from multiple AI models in one app

-Students, professionals, travelers, writers, and anyone who needs a single AI assistant for work, learning, travel, and daily life

Unlock the power of AI with you.com, the ultimate productivity engine for work. Designed to streamline workflows and improve decision making, you.com combines cutting-edge AI with enterprise-grade security.

• Get accurate answers to complex business questions. Combine web research with your company's data using the latest AI models. Our world-class platform performs computations, builds models, and reads hundreds of articles at blazing speeds—transforming raw data into actionable insights.

You.com is built for enterprise teams and professionals who demand speed, performance, accuracy, and security. From consulting firms to financial firms and everyone in between, professionals choose you.com because it's simply the most comprehensive AI research platform available.

Download now to transform how you work.

One app, many models, real results, infinite possibilities. Premium models (GPT-5 Thinking, Gemini 2.5 Pro, Claude 4.5 Sonnet, and others) available through in-app purchase.

record.description_evidence:
Grofy.AI is a sophisticated AI ecosystem built on world-leading large language models, including DeepSeek, ChatGPT (GPT-4o), Grok, Gemini, Claude, Qwen, Llama, and Mistral. More than just a chatbot, Grofy.AI is an intelligent partner designed to understand complex needs, provide expert guidance, and automate your most demanding tasks through continuous evolution.

Key Features:

1.Multi-Model AI Text & Code Generation
Instantly generate high-quality articles, reports, and creative content in any style or language. For developers, Grofy.AI writes, debugs, and optimizes code across various programming languages, accelerating your development workflow.

2.Next-Gen AI Image Creation (20+ Top-tier Models)Access a gallery of over 20 industry-leading image models, including Flux, Midjourney, Ideogram, DALL-E 3, and Stable Diffusion. Create high-definition visual masterpieces from simple prompts, with total control over aesthetic styles and precision.

3.Advanced AIAgent: Your Digital SecretaryOur new AIAgent transcends simple conversation. It acts as a "super-secretary" capable of deep content scraping and layout optimization. It intelligently parses web pages, PDFs, and Office docs, and can even convert social media content (LinkedIn, Reddit, Instagram, etc.) into clean, professional layouts.

4.ntelligent Knowledge Base & Web IntelligenceBuild a personal brain by uploading docx, pdf, or xls files for instant analysis. Use advanced headless browser technology to automatically catalog media assets from any webpage or capture high-definition full-page screenshots for your research.

5.Deep Search & Academic Excellence
A revolutionary search engine that understands complex queries. Access real-time global data, including a dedicated Academic Search for one-click access to professional papers (PubMed, Wikipedia, etc.), ensuring your information is always verified and cutting-edge.

6.YouTube Video Deep UnderstandingSave hours of viewing time. Grofy.AI can extract subtitles, summarize core concepts, and provide a deep analysis of YouTube videos, allowing you to grasp key insights in seconds.

7.Smart Geo-Location & Travel PlanningNavigate the world with AI. Benefit from location awareness, local business queries, and precise distance calculations. Plan multi-modal routes (driving, transit, walking) and discover surrounding attractions with ease.

8.AI Vision & Multi-Dimensional AnalysisPrecisely recognize and analyze objects, scenes, and text. From solving complex math and physics problems to identifying biological structures, Grofy.AI makes visual information instantly actionable.

9.Real-Time AI Voice Conversationngage in natural, low-latency voice dialogues. Utilizing advanced RTC technology, Grofy.AI provides a hands-free, human-like interaction experience for quick Q&A and language practice.

10.Seamless Multi-Model SwitchingOptimized for performance. Switch between different AI models with a single tap, ensuring you always use the best "brain" for your specific task, whether it’s creative writing, logical reasoning, or data analysis.

11.Personalized Study & Work AssistantBoost productivity with automated scheduling and personalized learning plans. Grofy.AI tracks your progress, handles routine admin tasks, and unlocks your creative potential, whether you are a student, professional, or business leader.

Privacy Policy: https://grofy.ai/privacy.html
Terms of Service: https://grofy.ai/service.html

record.name: ChatBot AI : Ask AI Assistant
record.offering: Education app; seller description requires review
record.description_evidence:
Wir präsentieren Ihnen einen neuen KI-Chat-Assistenten, der Sie beim Schreiben, Lösen von Problemen und sofortigen Antworten auf Ihre Fragen unterstützt. Dieser KI-Chatbot hilft Ihnen bei Ihren täglichen Aufgaben im Haushalt und im Büro – er wurde als praktischer Helfer entwickelt. Dank der intuitiven Benutzeroberfläche ist unsere App kinderleicht zu bedienen. Sie können chatten, schreiben, Probleme lösen und alles, was Sie brauchen, in Sekundenschnelle generieren. Die Chat-App versteht Ihre Fragen intuitiv. Sie können tippen, sprechen oder sogar ein Foto senden – die KI verarbeitet alles umgehend. Dieser KI-Chatbot kann professionelle Inhalte erstellen, ansprechende Bilder gestalten oder lange Dokumente zusammenfassen. Die KI ist jederzeit für Sie da.

Hauptfunktionen:

- KI-Bildgenerator:
Erstellen Sie beeindruckende Bilder mit einfachen Texteingaben. Beschreiben Sie Ihre Vorstellungen oder Wünsche – Charaktere, Szenen, Konzepte, Fotos, Poster oder Kunstwerke – und die KI generiert in Sekundenschnelle einzigartige Bilder. Der KI-Kunstgenerator bietet zahlreiche kreative Stile, mit denen Sie Bilder in verschiedenen künstlerischen Looks erstellen können, z. B. im Ghibli-Stil, im Anime-Stil, im Nano-Banana-Stil, mit Altersfilter-Transformationen und vielem mehr. Dieser KI-Bildgenerator eignet sich perfekt für Kreativität, Inspiration, Social-Media-Posts, Designideen und vieles mehr.

- KI-Chatbot & Sprachchat: Chatten Sie mit der KI wie mit einem Freund. Stellen Sie Fragen, erhalten Sie Vorschläge oder führen Sie alltägliche Gespräche. Wechseln Sie einfach zum Sprachchat, wenn Sie etwas effizienter erklären möchten, anstatt zu tippen. Die KI antwortet schnell und klar, sodass die Unterhaltungen reibungslos und angenehm verlaufen.

- Hintergrundentferner: Entfernen Sie Hintergründe in Sekundenschnelle von Ihren Fotos und erhalten Sie saubere, sofort einsatzbereite Bilder für Social Media, Design oder kreative Projekte – ganz ohne aufwendige Bearbeitung.

- Fragen erkennen & lösen (OCR & Bildleser): Erfassen Sie jedes Problem oder jede Frage, z. B. Matheaufgaben, Hausaufgaben, Anfragen, Anleitungen, Dokumente oder handschriftliche Notizen, und laden Sie diese in die App hoch. Die integrierte OCR- und Bilderkennung kann Texte aus Bildern scannen und extrahieren und sofort präzise Lösungen und Erklärungen generieren. Snap & Solve unterstützt Schüler, Studenten, Berufstätige und alle, die mit komplexen Informationen arbeiten.

- Sprachübersetzer: Übersetzen Sie Texte schnell in verschiedene Sprachen – mit präzisen und leicht verständlichen Ergebnissen. So wird Kommunikation und Lernen einfacher.

- Story-Generator & Schreibwerkzeuge: Erstellen Sie im Handumdrehen Geschichten, Ideen, Essays und andere Texte. Die KI unterstützt Sie beim kreativen Schreiben, der Content-Erstellung und der Verbesserung Ihrer Texte – für mehr Klarheit und Struktur.

- Dokumente und Texte zusammenfassen: Fügen Sie lange Texte ein oder laden Sie sie hoch und erhalten Sie schnell verständliche Zusammenfassungen. Diese Funktion ist ideal für Artikel, Aufgaben, Berichte oder Notizen, die Sie nicht vollständig lesen können.

Um Ihre Nutzung noch angenehmer zu gestalten, haben wir einige Beispielaufforderungen hinzugefügt. Diese Vorschläge zeigen Ihnen die Möglichkeiten der KI und helfen Ihnen, verschiedene Funktionen schnell zu entdecken – von Bildideen über Schreibaufgaben bis hin zu kreativen Anfragen.

Durch die Nutzung dieser App erklären Sie sich mit unserer Datenschutzrichtlinie und unseren Nutzungsbedingungen einverstanden:

Nutzungsbedingungen: https://www.apple.com/legal/internet-services/itunes/dev/stdeula/

Introducing a new Chat AI Assistant that will help you write, solve and get answers to your questions instantly. This AI Chatbot can help you in your daily household tasks or also your office tasks, it is created as a helper. With a smooth interface and user friendly behaviour, our app is very easy to understand. It helps you chat, write, solve, and generate anything you need in seconds. This chat AI app understands your questions naturally, you can type, voice, or even send a photo, and the AI will process everything instantly. This AI chatbot app can generate professional content and can also create fun images or summarizing long documents, this AI is ready to help you anytime.


Key Features:
- AI Image Generator:
Generate eye catching visuals using simple text prompts. Describe anything you imagine or want to create like characters, scenes, concepts, photos, posters, or artwork and the AI will generate unique images in seconds. The AI art generator also includes multiple creative styles, allowing you to create images in different artistic looks such as Ghibli inspired style, anime style artwork, Nano Banana style, age filter transformations, and other creative styles. This AI Image Generator is perfect for creativity, inspiration, social media posts, design ideas, and more.

- AI Chabot & Voice Chat:
Chat with AI the way you talk to a friend. Ask questions, get suggestions, or have daily conversations. You can also switch to voice chat when you want to explain a thing more efficiently instead of typing. The AI responds quickly and clearly, making conversations smooth and enjoyable.

- Background Remover:
Easily remove backgrounds from your photos in seconds and get clean, ready to use images for social media, design, or creative projects without any complex editing.

- Snap & Solve Questions (OCR & Image Reader):
Get a clear picture of any problem or issue like math questions, homework, queries, instructions, documents, or handwritten notes and upload them in the app. The built in OCR and image reader can scan and extract text from images and generate accurate solutions and explanations instantly. Snap & Solve helps students, professionals, and anyone dealing with complex information.

- Language Translator:
Translate text quickly into different languages with accurate and easy-to-understand results, making communication and learning more convenient.

- Story Generator & Writing Tools:
Create stories, ideas, essays, and other written content instantly. The AI helps with creative writing, content generation, and improving text with better clarity and structure.

- Summarize Documents and Texts:
Paste or upload long content and get quick, easy to understand summaries. This feature is perfect for articles, assignments, reports, or notes you don’t have time to read fully.

To make your experience even better, we’ve added some default example prompts. These suggestions show you what the AI can do and help you explore different features quickly from image ideas to writing tasks to creative requests.

record.description_evidence:
While most AI assistants overlook accessibility needs, Ally was designed with blind, low vision, and senior users at its heart from day one.

Created in close collaboration with the assistive tech community, Ally understands what true accessibility means.

Just call or text. No complex menus, no tiny buttons. Ally works seamlessly with your screen reader, responds at your pace, and remembers what matters to you.

Why people trust Ally:

For blind and low vision users, it's the assistant that actually gets it. For seniors, it's technology that finally feels simple. For caregivers, it's peace of mind. Built with the assistive tech community, tested by thousands who depend on it daily.

What Ally does for you:

• Reads mail, menus, signs, and documents instantly
• Describes your surroundings and identifies objects
• Answers questions with real-time web search
• Checks your calendar and weather
• Translates labels and text
• Scans and organizes important documents
• Plays trivia and adventure games
• Provides companionship when you need it

How Ally works:

Simply talk naturally or type. Ally understands your intent, chooses the right tool, and responds in a way that works for you. Personalize its voice, tone, and personality to match your preferences. Your Ally learns about you over time, from dietary needs to daily routines.

Use Ally anywhere:

Your personalized Ally works across iPhone, iPad, Mac, web browser, and compatible smart glasses like Envision Glasses and Ally Solos Glasses. Same experience, everywhere you go.

Subscription Plans:

Free: Unlimited 10-minute conversations
Ally Pro Monthly: Unlimited conversation length
Ally Pro Yearly: Best value for daily users

Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled 24+ hours before the current period ends. Manage subscriptions in Apple ID settings.

Join thousands who've made Ally their daily companion. Download now and experience AI that puts accessibility first.
